cards.title: One MedTech, several business units
cards.body:
J&J MedTech develops technologies used in operating rooms, catheterisation labs and eye clinics around the world. It is organised into business units, each focused on a group of medical specialties and the patients they treat.

Click a pod in the 3D scene to explore each business unit.

cards.title: Why business units?
cards.body: Each business unit knows its clinicians, procedures and patients deeply. From research through manufacturing to customer support, teams in a business unit work end to end on the same goal – better outcomes for their patients.

units.name: Cardiovascular
units.tagline: Treating heart rhythm disorders, heart failure and blocked arteries
units.description: The fastest-growing part of J&J MedTech. It combines leadership in electrophysiology with heart-recovery pumps and technology for calcified arteries.
focusAreas: Electrophysiology – mapping and ablation for heart rhythm disorders such as atrial fibrillation (heritage: Biosense Webster)
Heart Recovery – very small heart pumps that support a weak heart (heritage: Abiomed)
Shockwave – intravascular lithotripsy for calcified coronary and peripheral arteries
Laminar – a left atrial appendage technology in development

units.name: Surgery
units.tagline: Tools that help surgeons operate safely and precisely
units.description: Products used in open and minimally invasive surgery across many specialties – from closing wounds to robotic procedures.
focusAreas: Wound closure – sutures, skin adhesives and related products (heritage: Ethicon)
Surgical stapling and advanced energy devices that cut and seal tissue
Biosurgery – products that help control bleeding

units.name: Vision
units.tagline: Helping people see better at every stage of life
units.description: Covers everyday vision correction and eye surgery.
focusAreas: Contact lenses – including the ACUVUE brand
Surgical vision – intraocular lenses for cataract surgery and laser vision correction

units.name: Orthopaedics
units.tagline: Restoring movement – joints, trauma, spine and sports medicine
units.description: DePuy Synthes offers implants, instruments and enabling technologies for hips, knees, shoulders, trauma, spine and sports medicine.
focusAreas: Joint reconstruction – hips, knees and shoulders
units.note: In October 2025 J&J announced its intent to separate the Orthopaedics business into a standalone company operating as DePuy Synthes, targeted within 18–24 months. Check with your manager for the latest status.
